definedNames.Title: Split!$D$1
definedNames.GETSHEETNAMES:
LAMBDA(formularange, include_zero_totals, LET(
  txt, FORMULATEXT(formulaRange),
  inside, REGEXEXTRACT(txt, "sheetNames\s*,\s*\{([^\}]+)\}"),
  parts, SPLIT(inside, ","),
  sheetNames, ARRAYFORMULA(Substitute(REGEXREPLACE(TRIM(parts),"^'|'?!A1$",""),"''","'")),
  TRANSPOSE(
    IF(
      include_zero_totals,
      sheetNames,
      IfError(FILTER(
        sheetNames,
        MAP(sheetNames, LAMBDA(s, INDIRECT(s&"!Total")>0))
      ),)
    )
  )
))
definedNames.EXPAND_TO_LAST_NAME_COL:
LAMBDA(arg, LET(
  c, COLUMN(arg),
  w, MAX(IF(LEN(Split!$M$7:$7), COLUMN(Split!$M$7:$7) - c + 1)),
  OFFSET(arg, 0, 0, , If(w=0,1,w))
))
definedNames.JSON_PROP:
LAMBDA(name, value, wrapinquotes, IF(
  wrapInQuotes,
  """" & JSON_ESCAPE(name) & """:""" & JSON_ESCAPE(value) & """",
  """" & JSON_ESCAPE(name) & """:" & TO_TEXT(value)
))
definedNames.GET_SHEET_RANGE:
LAMBDA(name, LET(
    orgRange, SPLITSHEET_COL(Split!$C:$C),
    startRow, ROW(orgRange),
    endRow, LAST_ROW(orgRange),
    IF(endRow = 0, "null",
      LET(
        rowCount, endRow - startRow + 1,
        rng, ARRAY_CONSTRAIN(orgRange, rowCount, 1),
        r, SEQUENCE(rowCount, 1, startRow),
        match, BYROW(rng, LAMBDA(cell,
          LEFT(cell, LEN(name) + 1) = name & "!"
        )),
        count, COUNTIF(match, TRUE),
        IF(count = 0, "null",
          LET(
            matched, FILTER(r, match),
            "[" & MIN(matched) & "," & MAX(matched) & "]"
          )
        )
      )
    )
  ))

cells.formula:
ARRAYFORMULA(
  LET(
    headers, EXPAND_TO_LAST_NAME_COL(M7),
    groupsRaw, EXPAND_TO_LAST_NAME_COL(M6),
    balancesRaw, EXPAND_TO_LAST_NAME_COL(M5),

    hasGroupError,        SUMPRODUCT(N(ISERROR(groupsRaw))) > 0,
    hasBalanceError,      SUMPRODUCT(N(ISERROR(balancesRaw))) > 0,

    IF(
       (hasBalanceError+H3+NOT(A2))>0,
      ,
      LET(
        balances, ROUND(balancesRaw, 2),
        groups,   groupsRaw,
        step,     0.01,

        isPaidBySpecified, SUM(SPLITSHEET_COL(I:I)) > 0,
        errTotal, IF(isPaidBySpecified, SUM(balances), SUM(balances) - $A2),

        grp, IF(OR(hasGroupError,COUNTA(groups) = 0), IF(headers <> "", "ALL", ""), groups),

        baseCandidates,
          FILTER(
            TRIM(People!B:B),
            TRIM(People!B:B) <> "",
            ISNUMBER(MATCH(TRIM(People!B:B), headers, 0))
          ),

        adj,
          MAP(
            headers, grp,
            LAMBDA(h, g,
              LET(
                groupHeaders, FILTER(headers, grp = g),
                groupCandidates,
                  FILTER(
                    baseCandidates,
                    ISNUMBER(MATCH(baseCandidates, groupHeaders, 0)),
                    XLOOKUP(baseCandidates, headers, balances) <> 0
                  ),
                err, IF(isPaidBySpecified, SUM(FILTER(balances, grp = g)), errTotal),
                k,  MIN(ABS(ROUND(err / step, 0)), COUNTA(groupCandidates)),
                pos, IFERROR(MATCH(h, groupCandidates, 0), 1000000000),
                IF(err = 0, 0, IF(pos <= k, -SIGN(err) * step, 0))
              )
            )
          ),

        ROUND(balances + adj, 2)
      )
    )
  )
)

cells.formula:
ArrayFormula(ROUND(
BYCOL(
      EXPAND_TO_LAST_NAME_COL(M7:M17),
      LAMBDA(
        col,
        LET(
          header, INDEX(col, 1),
          IF(header="",,LET( 
          splits, OFFSET(col, 3, 0),
          explicitAssignments, Map(SPLITSHEET_COL($C:$C),Lambda(it,Indirect(REGEXREPLACE(it,"F\d+$", "ExplicitPayers")))),
          SUM(SPLITSHEET_COL($H:$H) * TRUNC(splits) - SPLITSHEET_COL($G:$G) *
                IF(
                  IsBlank(explicitAssignments),
                  MOD(splits, 1) * 10,
                  Map(explicitAssignments,Lambda(eAssignment,IF(
                  COUNTIF(
                    TRIM(SPLIT(eAssignment, ",")),
                    header
                  ) > 0,1,0)))
                  
                ))
        )))
      )
    ),
    3
))

      ARRAYFORMULA(EXPAND_TO_LAST_NAME_COL(SPLITSHEET_COL(M:M))),

cells.formula:
LET(
  data, FILTER(A:B, B:B<>SelectedMainCurrencyAbbr),
  sheetNames, GETSHEETNAMES(Split!D9, TRUE),
  usedCurrencies,
    UNIQUE(
      TOCOL(
        MAP(
          sheetNames,
          LAMBDA(s, INDIRECT(s & "!C1"))
        ),
        1
      )
    ),
  priority,
    MAP(
      INDEX(data,,1),
      LAMBDA(cur,
        IF(
          cur="Default",
          0,
          IF(COUNTIF(usedCurrencies, cur), 1, 2)
        )
      )
    ),
  SORT(
    data,
    priority, TRUE,
    SEQUENCE(ROWS(data)), TRUE
  )
)

        ),
